mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate relative to historical norms compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.10%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes corporate earnings contraction and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: During a period of rising industrial production (INDPRO) above 100.5, the economy is in an expansion phase that supports corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 100.5.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% signals accelerating inflation, which typically leads to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in residential construction (HOUST) below 1150.0 thousand units signals a weakening housing market, which typically precedes a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST falls below 1150.0.

mechanism_narrative: During a period of high labor force participation (PAYEMS growth above 0.5% monthly), the labor market is tight, supporting consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 4.0% and 3.0% respectively signal a monetary tightening cycle, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL exceed their thresholds.
